description: This file defines data structures, macros, and function prototypes for handling buffalo firmware tags, encryption, checksum calculations, and file operations in a firmware utility library.

methods.name: enc_compute_header_len
methods.description: Calculates the length of the firmware header based on product and version strings.

methods.name: enc_compute_buf_len
methods.description: Calculates the buffer length for encrypted data based on product, version, and data length.

methods.name: encrypt_buf
methods.description: Encrypts data using specified encryption parameters.

methods.name: decrypt_buf
methods.description: Decrypts data using specified encryption parameters.

methods.name: buffalo_csum
methods.description: Computes a checksum over a buffer.

methods.name: buffalo_crc
methods.description: Computes a CRC over a buffer.

methods.name: get_file_size
methods.description: Returns the size of a file.

methods.name: read_file_to_buf
methods.description: Reads a file into a buffer.

methods.name: write_buf_to_file
methods.description: Writes a buffer to a file.
